title: Case 012: Promised delivery day missed after vehicle breakdown

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The carrier confirms its vehicle breakdown prevented delivery on the promised day. Dispatch needs to schedule a replacement attempt.
initial_request: Yesterday’s booked window was missed and I still have no parcel. I am free on 2026-02-14 in the afternoon. Please arrange a replacement slot.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask dispatch for a replacement delivery slot.

outcome: Dispatch confirms a replacement booking and the customer acknowledges the revised plan.
boundaries: Customer acknowledgement closes rebooking only, not delivery.

events.body: DL-012 was due on 2026-02-12, 08:00–09:00 UTC. Vehicle fault V-12 ended that route at 08:20 on that day; the parcel is back in depot custody and was not delivered.
Yesterday’s booked window was missed and I still have no parcel. I am free on 2026-02-14 in the afternoon. Please arrange a replacement slot.
Please rebook DL-012 after the confirmed breakdown. Fenn can receive it on 2026-02-14 afternoon; confirm a specific available window and any charge.
Replacement booking: 2026-02-14, 14:00–17:00 UTC, no extra charge. We have reserved capacity and sent the revised booking to Fenn.
I received the 2026-02-14, 14:00–17:00 booking and will be home. Thank you for arranging it.
